blocker.observed: Before any candidate metric was produced, exact history_match subset enumeration expanded combinatorially when the response vector grew from three to eleven Agents.
blocker.scope: The blocker affects a prior compression control, not difficulty_persistence_match or difficulty_markov_match.
blocker.evidence: The first full command was interrupted after more than six minutes while materializing the first history_match memberships; no result artifact was written.

resolution.primary_history_match: Rematerialize the previously frozen history_match control from the three Agents listed in existing_opened_development_panel, then evaluate those memberships on all eleven development Agents.
resolution.leave_one_agent_history_match: When the evaluated Agent belongs to the original three-Agent panel, rematerialize history_match from the other two original Agents; otherwise retain all three original Agents.
resolution.temporal_null: Materialize only difficulty_markov_match because it is the sole null-tested candidate. Do not recompute history_match or the persistence ablation inside a Markov null permutation.

claim_boundary: history_match remains the exact prior three-Agent compression control rather than a newly optimized eleven-Agent comparator. Full history remains the primary no-selection baseline.
